name: @sauce/zk
description: SauceScript's ZK-coprocessor requests: a question now, and the `.then` body run on the same Private Pot when the proven answer is called back, as a promise of @sauce/async's. `Zk.sql(query)` asks Space and Time a SQL query, proven with Proof of SQL, paying in SXT; its promise is parked under the query's id and expires at the query's timeout, when `Zk.cancel(e)` in its `.catch` takes the payment back; `Zk.cell`/`Zk.rows` read the result's table. `queryCallback` is the body of the handler the Pot answers Space and Time's callback with. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (zk.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the coprocessors' contracts are EVM contracts.
